$comment: Dependency license policy (ADR-0008, P01 engineering/license-compliance). Checked by scripts/check-licenses.mjs. Exceptions need a maintainer decision recorded in approvedBy. devOnlyExceptions record approved licenses of development-only dependencies (not checked: check-licenses covers production dependencies).

permissiveBoundary.$comment: ADR-0008 §4 (P07 task 7.9): the Extension SDK, the theme contract and the extension types (@heopress/contracts: ./theme, ./extensions) and the API client plugins may call are Apache-2.0, carry a LICENSE file and depend on no AGPL core package and on nothing off the allow list; the exceptions below do not apply to them.

exceptions.reason: libvips native library loaded by sharp as a separate shared library; replaceable by the user.

devOnlyExceptions.scope: devDependency of @heopress/public-site only: injected into a test browser page by the starter-theme accessibility check; never bundled, shipped in an image or published
devOnlyExceptions.reason: Task P06 5.1 requires an axe accessibility check; no permissively licensed equivalent of axe exists.
